nextest.name: a scope keeps only its own quick overrides under the current root
a scope without overrides equals the root

dependabot.valid:
version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: "gomod"
    directories:
      - "/mod/a"
      - "/mod/b"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
  - package-ecosystem: "bun"
    directories:
      - "/pkg/*"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
  - package-ecosystem: "github-actions"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
dependabot.invalid:
version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: "gomod"
    directories:
      - "/mod/a"
      - "/mod/gone"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
  - package-ecosystem: "bun"
    directories:
      - "/mod/a"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
invalidProblems: .github/dependabot.yml: go.work module mod/b has no gomod entry
